english.name: gold_gather_Gold

english.name: gold_gather_Silver

english.name: Building_Gold

english.name: Building_Silver

english.description: A true Destroyer smites all his enemies, leaving only dead bodies in his wake.
english.name: damage_Gold

english.description: You try to only engage in battle on your terms. But you also take a lot of pleasure from crushing your enemies.
english.name: damage_Silver

english.description: Sages believe that direct conflict does not always lead to victory.
english.name: damage_Bronze

english.description: The great Invincible hero loses only a few small battles, but wins all others.
english.name: defeats_Gold

english.description: А decent Veteran wins as many battles as he loses.
english.name: defeats_Silver

english.description: A general may win the war even if he loses a lot of battles. But his soldiers will call him Training Dummy.
english.name: defeats_Bronze

english.description: Real Tomb Raiders love to explore all kinds of ancient and mystical ruins.
english.name: dungeons_Gold

english.description: When you were young, you explored all the attics and cellars in the neighborhood. And now you are filled with desire to explore the rest of the world.
english.name: dungeons_Silver

english.description: You may explore a dungeon or two every now and then.
english.name: dungeons_Bronze

english.description: Only a hero who has visited every nook and cranny in the land can be called Great Explorer.
english.name: fog_of_war_Gold

english.description: All true Explorers map the new lands they have discovered.
english.name: fog_of_war_Silver

english.description: The Traveler is a hero who does not look into each nook and cranny, searching for secrets and treasure.
english.name: fog_of_war_Bronze

english.description: Brave heroes always rush into the heat of battle.
english.name: game_loads_Gold

english.description: A Careful hero is prudent. He studies his options thoroughly.
english.name: game_loads_Silver

english.description: Cowardly heroes always play it safe.
english.name: game_loads_Bronze

english.description: You take excellent care of your followers. That's why they call you the Healer!
english.name: heal_Gold

english.description: You are sickened by the sight of blood and do everything in your power to keep your followers healthy.
english.name: heal_Silver

english.description: A Quack can heal various indispositions and light wounds.
english.name: heal_Bronze

english.description: Real Wanderers explore all the roads and paths they find.
english.name: long_way_Gold

english.description: Some heroes like to look for shortcuts and explore secret paths.
english.name: long_way_Silver

english.description: Walkers go straight to their destination and never turn off the road. They are not interested in exploration.
english.name: long_way_Bronze

english.description: The Archmage can destroy enemies by using the most powerful spells.
english.name: magic_use_Gold

english.description: Wizards know the power of magic well, which is why they use spells quite often.
english.name: magic_use_Silver

english.description: Wizard Apprentices rely on the strength of their armies and only rarely use magic.
english.name: magic_use_Bronze

english.description: You have collected a huge amount of Earth Magic. Nothing is impossible for you.
english.name: mearth_gather_Gold

english.description: You have enough Earth Magic to use it any time you need.
english.name: mearth_gather_Silver

english.description: You have a meager amount of Earth Magic. You rarely use Earth Magic.
english.name: mearth_gather_Bronze

english.description: A true Fire Magic Guardian uses a lot of the infernal energy in all his undertakings.
english.name: mhell_gather_Gold

english.description: The Fire Magic you have collected can be used to great advantage.
english.name: mhell_gather_Silver

english.description: ou do not rely on Fire Magic in battle.
english.name: mhell_gather_Bronze

english.description: You have a huge amount of Life Magic and your possibilities are endless.
english.name: mlife_gather_Gold

english.description: You have an adequate amount of Life Magic.
english.name: mlife_gather_Silver

english.description: You have been able to collect some Life Magic.
english.name: mlife_gather_Bronze

english.description: You are addicted to various potions. Some people laugh at you behind your back.
english.name: potion_use_Gold

english.description: A Taster knows a lot about potions. That is why he uses them in every major battle.
english.name: potion_use_Silver

english.description: Everyone knows that you are an Abstainer, because you are absolutely against the use of potions.
english.name: potion_use_Bronze

english.description: You do not allow Fate to govern the lives of your followers. You rule over them yourself.
english.name: ressurect_Gold

english.description: If your followers fall in battle, you try to get them back from the realm of Mortis.
english.name: ressurect_Silver

english.description: Fatalists believe in Fate and do not try to resurrect fallen warriors.
english.name: ressurect_Bronze

english.description: The amount of stone you have is incredible. Only Quarry Owners have as much of this resource.
english.name: stone_gather_Gold

english.description: You have collected a considerable amount of stone. It is enough to build any building.
english.name: stone_gather_Silver

english.description: Construction is not your favorite hobby. The amount of stone you have is not enough to build even a small town.
english.name: stone_gather_Bronze

english.description: If you have captured all the surrounding lands, then you are the great Conqueror of Peoples.
english.name: territory_Gold

english.description: The Conqueror of Cities is a hero who is able to capture almost all known lands.
english.name: territory_Silver

english.description: The Conqueror of Villages does not seek to capture all surrounding lands.
english.name: territory_Bronze

english.description: The Commander is a great organizer, able to lead large armies of followers.
english.name: hero_hire_Gold

english.description: A true Leader is one who can unite several trusty heroes into a strong team.
english.name: hero_hire_Silver

english.description: Some heroes do not have much use for trusty sidekicks. They believe in their abilities only.
english.name: hero_hire_Bronze

english.description: You give no quarter to your enemies. You are Death incarnate.
english.name: unit_kill_Gold

english.description: The true Warrior destroys his enemies mercilessly and no obstacle can stop him.
english.name: unit_kill_Silver

english.description: Learned men call him a Pacifist, but they do not say what the word means. In any case, he rarely draws his sword.
english.name: unit_kill_Bronze
